# Review page metadata and sharing previews

Check the HTML head and decide which site-specific metadata the new theme needs. Treat social-preview imagery separately from homepage and post hero images.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Page titles and descriptions are appropriate for the homepage, posts, pages, tags and not-found view.
- [ ] Any added social metadata uses available site/document data and is safely encoded; missing optional images or descriptions do not produce broken tags.
- [ ] Asset and canonical URLs, if introduced, work with the site's base URL rather than assuming the site is hosted at the domain root.
- [ ] The chosen social-preview image policy is documented in the theme design, including a deliberate decision if no additional metadata is needed.
